name: ListAccessRules

parameters.help_en: The ID of the access group
parameters.name: access_group_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies the starting position of the query.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
指定查询起始位置。

默认值：1
parameters.name: start_offset

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries to return on each page.

Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
每页返回结果的行数。

默认值：10
parameters.name: limit

parameters.help_en:
The field by which to sort the returned results.

Valid values:

Priority (default): sort by priority
CreateTime: sort by creation time
parameters.help_zh:
返回结果排序字段。

取值：

Priority（默认值）：按优先级排序。
CreateTime：按创建时间排序
parameters.name: order_by

parameters.help_en:
The sort order of the returned results.

Valid values:

ASC (default): ascending order
DESC: descending order
parameters.help_zh:
返回结果排序方式。

取值：

ASC（默认值）：升序
DESC：降序
parameters.name: order_type

parameters.help_en:
The token for the next page.

If a single query does not return all entries, a non-empty NextToken is returned. You can specify the NextToken in a subsequent query to continue the query
parameters.help_zh:
下一页标识。

如果一次查询结果并没有完整返回所有的目录，则返回 NextToken 不为空。您可以在查询中上传正确的 NextToken 继续查询
parameters.name: next_token

AccessGroupId.description_en: The ID of the access group

AccessRuleId.description_en: The ID of the access group rule

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the access group rule was created. The time is displayed in UTC and follows the ISO 8601 standard. Example: 2022-04-18T08:02:09.986217Z
CreateTime.description_zh: 权限组规则的创建时间。采用 ISO 8601 格式的 UTC 时间，例如 2022-04-18T08:02:09.986217Z

Description.description_en: The description of the access group rule
Description.description_zh: 权限组规则的描述信息

NetworkSegment.description_en: The IP address or CIDR block of the authorized object
NetworkSegment.description_zh: 授权对象的IP地址或网段

Priority.description_en:
The priority of the access group rule.

If an authorized object matches multiple rules, the rule with the highest priority takes effect.

Valid values: 1 to 100. A value of 1 indicates the highest priority
Priority.description_zh:
权限组规则优先级。

当同一个授权对象匹配到多条规则时，高优先级规则生效。

取值范围：1~100，1为最高优先级

RWAccessType.description_en:
The read and write permissions of the authorized object on the file system.

Valid values:

RDWR: read and write
RDONLY: read-only
RWAccessType.description_zh:
授权对象对文件系统的读写权限。

包括：

RDWR：可读可写
RDONLY：只读

NextToken.description_en:
The token for the next page.

If a single query does not return all entries, a non-empty NextToken is returned. You can specify the NextToken in a subsequent query to continue the query
NextToken.description_zh:
下一页标识。

如果一次查询结果并没有完整返回所有的目录，则返回 NextToken 不为空。您可以在查询中上传正确的 NextToken 继续查询

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of returned results
